expected.oracleOptimization: enumerate every complete choice sequence; no state merging or DP

resources.observationScope: Sampled process memory, not continuous/RSS hard cap or phone measurement; full readouts released by runCase scope, normal GC timing uncontrolled.

patch.format: ordinary git diff a/src b/src; git apply on accepted baseline, no QA path resolver or source regeneration

compatibilityAliases.purpose: EC1 applyEventClockAnalysis bridge; historical filename retained only for the frozen Chart integration
EC1 selectEventClockOnsets finite selector; historical filename retained only for integration

analysisMetadata.purpose: Actual EC1 clock metadata plus always-serializable immutable chart normalization; neither is a filename alias.

manifest.scope: Source-only passive archive. No source imports, candidate/helper/optimizer/Chart/analyzer/FFT calls, audio/PCM reads, metrics, tracked writes, commits or publication.

expectedIndependentVerification.command: ordinary git apply --check then git apply in a separate QA baseline tree
expectedIndependentVerification.compare: all31 applied files vs actual frozen C source bytes

workScope: Returned work is source self-report. fitWork.maximum* are sums of per-fit maxima, not global peaks. Failed applications have no returned work; failing owner and full frontier are unknown.
limitations: Only the fixed original41 observed development cache; no fresh/sealed music.
Five observed clips are five genre proxies, not a ten-genre population.
Inherited B rejection is not an actual C analyzer rejection or end-to-end status parity.
Clock metric uses Analysis.rhythm.beats; B low-support chartBeats can differ from that sequence. Head metric uses uniqueHeads of the one-finger chart.
Local affine source fits, finite exact path, physical onset pool, count retention and identity are separate.
A single bounded Node run does not establish phone performance, perceived musical quality or a full pipeline test.

Five frontier-budget application failures stay empty in every original metric denominator. Four of five music calls failed, so these macros cannot establish the alignment of a successfully completed EC1 music tracker.
Successful returned controls also show a slow metrical level: source fits and normalization correctness do not establish primary tactus.
Detailed failed path owner/frontier/partial output was not saved; do not invent it.
